budget_scope: New user-authorized 6h/4h campaign; old stopped/broad/diagnostic ledgers are immutable ancestry, not reset or resumed. Shared retained storage is conservatively capped at30GiB.

resource_scopes.wall: Whole campaign since original start, including preparation, reporting and publication
resource_scopes.GPU: Charged reserved process wall, plus explicitly charged conservative legacy regression; live pending time shown separately
resource_scopes.CPU_worker: Completed CPU job process wall; overlaps campaign wall and GPU activities
resource_scopes.process_CPU: Handler parent-process CPU only; subprocess and auxiliary test CPU are not a complete aggregate
resource_scopes.cache: All new campaign bytes, bounded by conservative retained-ancestor30GiB allowance
resource_scopes.downloads: Pinned source files and GitHub tree responses; no new data/model downloads
resource_scopes.publication: Remote commit proof is verified separately after normal push

known_lineage_sum_scope: Arithmetic sum of separately scoped historical campaign records and this campaign, including pending live time; historical limits and ledgers remain unchanged.
